title: Tamil Nadu Regulation of Rights and Responsibilities of Landlords and Tenants Act, 2017 (TNRRRLT Act)
organization: Government of Tamil Nadu / Housing & Urban Development Department
excerpt: This Act establishes a framework for rights and responsibilities of landlords and tenants in Tamil Nadu. It includes provisions regarding security deposits, notice periods, and dispute resolution. Visit https://www.tn.gov.in/acts-rules for current text. Specific rules, timelines, and applicability depend on whether the agreement is registered and other facts — consult a qualified professional for your specific situation.

title: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 - Free Legal Services & Lok Adalat
excerpt: Section 12: Free legal services provided to women, children, persons with annual income under statutory threshold, workers, and victims of injustice. Pre-litigation mediation is freely accessible at District Legal Services Authorities.

title: Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority (TNSLSA) & High Court Mediation Centre
organization: Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority
excerpt: Alternative dispute resolution mechanism offering free pre-litigation settlement conferences before judicial officers and trained advocates at District Court and Taluk levels.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 & E-Daakhil Portal
organization: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
excerpt: Consumers can file complaints digitally through e-Daakhil against deficiency in service, unfair trade practices, and misleading terms without mandatory advocate engagement.

title: Payment of Wages Act, 1936 & Industrial Dispute Redressal
organization: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
excerpt: Section 5 & 15: Wages must be paid within the prescribed wage period (7 to 10 days post period). Unlawful deductions or delayed wages can be recovered through an application before the Labour Commissioner / Payment of Wages Authority.

title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal & IT Act, 2000
organization: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs
excerpt: Citizens can lodge financial fraud and cybercrime incidents directly via Helpline 1930 or online. In financial frauds, prompt reporting within the 'golden hour' enables lien-marking and fund freezing by nodal banking desks.

title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 - Breach of Contract & Restitution
organization: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
excerpt: Section 73: When a contract is broken, the party suffering breach is entitled to compensation for direct loss naturally arising. Section 65 requires any advantage received under void or discharged obligations to be restored.

title: eCourts Integrated Mission Mode Project
excerpt: Case status tracking, cause lists, daily orders, and certified digital copies for all District and Subordinate Courts across India.
